newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list Gulfstream Aerospace options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list Gulfstream Aerospace options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said on Friday it would list options on Gulfstream Aerospace Corp on January 17.
The exchange said the options would open with strike prices of 20, 22-1/2 and 25 and expirations in February, March, June and September.
Shares of the airplane designer and maker were down 1/4 at 22-5/8 on Friday afternoon.
Saliba Partners has been named the Designated Primary Market Maker (DPM) in the options, the CBOE said. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
